title: Drill Mode
paragraphs: “What’s up?”
“Well, my gut and my nose are telling me something’s up. Could you let me take a look at that door?”
I turn my gaze toward Father. He gives me a nod, as if to say, “Leave it to me.” Panda checks the front door.
“Just as I thought… there’s a trap set here. A very elaborate one, at that.”
Panda points to various spots, like the doorknob and other places. There seem to be quite a few of them. But Panda goes about disarming them one by one, clicking them open as she goes.
“Lasa’s really handy with that sort of thing.”
“Elmelo, you know a thing or two about this, don’t you? Give her a hand.”
“Yeah, yeah.”
It looks like Zou is doing something to match Panda’s movements. He’s tapping his feet lightly.
“No sign of anyone in the room beyond the entrance… though, there’s something there… probably near the stairs… That’s odd, isn’t it?”

Ah, she’s checking the room ahead using vibrations. Father from the first world found disarming these kinds of traps a hassle, so he just broke through using his formidable Defense Power. I get the feeling that Zou can do some of the same things as Big Sister’s older sister. After all, I’ve heard that Big Sister’s older sister can sense what’s on the other side of a wall.
“Ah… looks like something’s connected by a wire on the other side of the door… It knows how to detect Magical Power vibrations, so even a stronger vibration will trigger a reaction. But… here goes.”
With a snip, Panda deftly pulled the wire out through the crack in the door.
“This is as far as we can get from the door. Let’s hurry up and open it so we can disarm the trap inside.”
“Leave it to me!”

Since Panda cleared the way, I’ll go first to open the door and head inside. In the entrance hall were a square lump of clay and some kind of device. On top of that, countless turret-like structures were set up, aimed right at us.
“What the—!?”
Both Panda and Zou stared around the room with stunned expressions. Is this really something to be that surprised about?
“Oh no! Air Strike Shield X! Second Shield X! And Shield Prison!”

On the spot, Father raised his shields to protect us from the turrets and trapped the clay-like contraption inside a shield cage. Well then, I’ll fire this to break through Father’s precautionary defenses.
“Aiming Lancer X!”
In sync with Father’s voice, I’ll use the Aiming Lancer to blast right through everything aimed at the turret. I reduced the turret to dust with my lance.

By the way, since Panda was holding down the wire that triggered it, the trap itself didn’t go off. Panda really comes in handy in situations like this. But if Father had been standing in front of it, I’m sure he could’ve neutralized it.
“It really feels like they’re out to kill us… But the fact that they set this up so meticulously means our movements were completely exposed.”
“Yeah… Maybe we should’ve come with a smaller group?”
“Hmm… Gaelion’s reading says it’s suspicious. More importantly, Naofumi, what are we going to do about that trap we locked ourselves in earlier?”
“Can you handle it, Lars-chan?”
“I can, but honestly, wouldn’t it be faster just to trigger it? It’s not actually connected to anything else, anyway.”
“Got it. Lars-chan, please.”
“Sure thing.”
With a sharp tug, Panda pulls the wire on the remaining trap, setting it off. A loud “Boom!” echoes from the shield prison that Father created.
“If the sound and shockwaves from the Shield Prison I just created are leaking this far out… that must be a pretty massive bomb.”
“Looks like it really was a bomb after all. Based on my instincts… I think it’s powerful enough to blow this whole mansion to smithereens.”
“Should we retreat?”
“I think that’s jumping the gun, but even if they’re hiding somewhere, it’s probably a place they consider safe. It’s unlikely they’re inside the mansion. Let’s check a few rooms just in case.”
And so, we decided to search the mansion.
The interior of the mansion was quite spacious, with all sorts of amenities and guest rooms—it practically seemed tailor-made for a vacation.
“It’s gotten to the point where it wouldn’t be the least bit surprising if it were marketed as a tourist destination.”
Éclair muttered this after surveying the residential area of the island.

“That’s true… It’s not quite on the scale of Cal Mira Island, but there’s really no other way to describe it than as an island set up by someone incredibly wealthy… And the fact that there’s no one else here besides us just adds to the eerie atmosphere.”

It seems there are countless facilities, from the kitchen on up. Hmm… Burning it to the ground would be one option, but once this matter is resolved, it might not be a bad idea to commandeer it as a retreat for Filolial-sama and his entourage. In fact, it wouldn’t be half bad to reward our informant’s organization by letting them use the very hideout where the remnants of the Takt faction were hiding—a truly lavish reward.
Perhaps we could make it the final stop on the Filolial Luxury Cruise Concert Tour? …My imagination is running wild.
“Oh? I think I smell a trace of Filolial-sama.”

I detected a lingering scent reminiscent of Filolial-sama coming from near the ranch behind us. However, there was no sign of him at the ranch itself. I ran all over that ranch area with Filolial-sama and the others, tracking Takt’s traces and Filolial-sama’s scent. But… the trail veered toward the sea partway through and simply vanished.
“I guess the next step is to search the forest that stretches behind the mansion?”
“Hey!”
Just then, Panda came over to call us.
“Lars-chan, what’s up? Did you find something?”
“It wasn’t me—it was Elmelo who found it—but I’d like you to come take a look.”
“Okay.”

So, with Panda leading the way, we were guided to a chapel-like building on the island. Inside the chapel is a pig statue that strongly resembles the Crimson Swine itself. I guess I’ll go smash it later. In front of the chapel, Zou is pacing back and forth for some reason.
“Elmelo, is something wrong?”
“Well, I wouldn’t exactly say ‘wrong’…”
The elephant was stamping its feet over and over.
“From the feel of the ground, I can tell there’s some kind of mechanism around here… and I can sense what seems to be a passageway leading further ahead.”
“Some kind of mechanism, huh… Hmm.”
“Let’s go for it—”
Since Rival seems ready to suggest something, I’ll cut him off.
“Straight from Father in the First World! (It’s Naofumi’s favorite.) We’re going to power through it! (Ignoring the mechanism and just powering through!)”
Everyone’s gaze turns to Father at Rival’s and my words.
“Well, I actually like that. Solving mysterious traps is such a hassle, even in dungeons.”
“Wait, I’m not sure if it’s right to say ‘I like it’… but yeah, I get that it’s a hassle. It’s not like we’re here to play a puzzle-solving game, after all. So, what should we do?”
“Please let me handle this! I’ve even broken through the traps on the Spirit Tortoise’s body!”
“I’d hate it if there were any weird traps or something… Elmelo, do you know what’s up?”
“Yes… I think we’ll probably be fine.”
“I figure even I could use Magic to force my way through this kind of trap, but it’d probably be easier to let the Spear Hero handle it first.”
So, I’m going to blast my way through the passage in front of the chapel where this contraption is supposed to be.
“I’m copying Filo-tan’s special move! Spiral Drill! Drill Mode in Drive Mode! Here we go!”
Spinning my spear forward at high speed, as if turning a wheel, I dig straight through the ground. With a grinding sound, I plowed through the mechanism and cleared a path to the passageway.
“I’ve cleared a path!”
For some reason, Father and the others are just standing there in silence, watching me emerge from the hole.
“So you don’t just say ‘Brionac!’ and blast your way through, do you…”
“Oh, I thought so too.”
“Me too.”
Father is nodding at the pandas’ words.
“Somehow, it just felt natural to let Motoyasu-kun do it… but this ‘Drill Mode’ thing—”
“If that’s what you wish, I’ll dig as far as you want.”

This is the specialty of the moles who were with Father in the first world. Those guys are even kind to Filolial-sama… Aside from that incident in the previous loop when Kou made a fuss about wanting to eat them, they’re actually good guys.
“No, it’s nothing… I’m just glad Motoyasu-kun is digging just the right amount.”
“We’re truly grateful!”
Ha ha ha! Rival, I can control my strength too, you know! Do you get it now?
“Actually, since I can use earth magic, I could’ve just manipulated the ground to open it up myself.”
Zou looks a bit apologetic, but there’s no need to worry.
“You shouldn’t let it bother you.”
“What did you say?! What on earth is wrong with me?!”
“Exactly! What’s wrong with Motoyasu-sama’s method… at all?!”
“Yuki-chan, I really don’t think you need to hold back on this one, okay?”
Father seems to be trying to reason with Yuki-chan—could there be something going on?
“That’s not true at all. It’s a smart method—stopping just in time without digging too deep into the ground. I think it’s actually faster than Magic.”
“I’ll admit that fine-tuning it is tough… and if there’s hard bedrock, the difficulty goes up too.”

“So there are all sorts of ways to solve traps besides just puzzle-solving or picking locks… Maybe even those ‘teleportation failures’ in that game—if you used earth magic to create a space, you could prevent instant death…”
Father is muttering things like that to himself.
“Speaking of which, Sakura-chan…”
Although she’s silent, Sakura-chan is here too, protecting Father from Rival.
“Hmm?”
“Do you happen to know a technique called ‘Spiral Strike’?”

Filo-tan is Sakura-chan. In other words, it wouldn’t be surprising if Sakura-chan could use a similar technique as well. Well, among the Filolial-sama, it’s a move that quite a few of them can use… But the best user of all is Filo-tan!
“Isn’t it ‘High-Speed Strike’ instead?”

Ah, that’s right. Sakura-chan uses a move where she accelerates instantly, passes right by her opponent, and slashes them with her wings. Come to think of it, that might have been one of the reasons I thought Sakura-chan and Filo-tan were different.
“That’s right.”
“Hmm?”
The way she tilts her head does indeed remind me of Filo-tan, but since it’s a pose many Filolial-sama often strike, I can’t really find a common thread there.
“I think I can probably do it—”
“I bet you can!”

Since Filolial-sama doesn’t possess any Attributes other than Wind, this must be a technique she can use. There are countless variations of Filolial-sama’s techniques, such as when she generates wind blades with her kicks.
“So Filolial can do Drill Mode too… I’ll tell Rat-san about it later.”
“Don’t you think the vet in Faubrey might actually be more interested in the Spear Hero?”
“I can’t deny that. Anyway, let’s flush out the remaining Takt forces! Lars-chan. Elmelo. Please be very careful of traps.”
“Got it. This is way more rewarding than working at a castle or doing security duty. Let’s keep an eye out for scents and such as we search.”
“Demi-Humans and Beastmen are far better suited for this sort of thing than humans… Maybe I should learn a thing or two myself…”

And so, in this manner, we made our way through the secret passages of Takt’s mansion. Along the way… we passed countless places, including what looked like a research facility and mysterious empty rooms. It was a far cry from the resort we’d been at earlier. I’m sure Takt and his crew were up to no good here.
“I wonder if they were conducting some kind of research?”
“It’s Takt, after all. I’m sure he was conducting some kind of research, wasn’t he?”
“He was considered a genius, after all… Maybe some kind of illegal research? There were plenty of things that looked like cultivation capsules, too.”
“Even though he was already working on Shieldfreeden, was he doing it here as well?”
“There are signs that it was still active until very recently…”
“So maybe it’s unrelated to Takt?”
Just then, Panda sniffs toward the empty room.
“It smells…”
“Does it smell like something?”
Zou tilts his head at Panda’s words. Of course, Filolial-sama does too. But Filolial-sama, just like Zou, tilts his head as well. I’m doing the same. Does it really smell like that?
Sniff, sniff! I sort of sense the scent of hunting thieves.
“Does it smell weird? I don’t think so.”
“Well, it’s not a direct scent, is it? This is what they call the scent of valuables. It’s the scent of something valuable that was here until just recently.”
What kind of smell is that?! Wait, so the smell of hunting bandits is the “smell of something valuable”? I think I sort of get it now.
“Ah… you’re right. Someone like Rasa could probably distinguish that kind of scent.”
“I see. So this is the scent of gold. I thought it was the scent of bandits.”
“Spear Hero, it’s probably different from the scent you sensed.”
Hmm… That’s tricky.
“Still, there was an incredibly strong scent of gold… I’m really impressed that they could carry this much around.”
“So does that mean this is where the money the remaining Takt members had been hiding was gathered?”
“I’d say so.”
The panda scratches the ground a little with its claws. A tiny bit of something that looks like gold dust clings to the tips of its claws.
“They must’ve been carrying enough valuables to make it stick.”
“Hmm…”
“I can’t wait to see the real thing. Let’s get a move on.”

There was also a gunpowder magazine. A time bomb had been planted there, and it was about to explode, but thanks to the quick thinking of Panda and Father, they managed to defuse it. Father is dumbfounded, saying it was “pure murderous intent.”
